summary.text: Application database connections failed while the database reported almost all configured connection slots in use.

impact.text: An orders request returned HTTP 503 after a database connection acquisition timeout.

observations.text: PostgreSQL rejected a connection because remaining slots were reserved.
A single sample showed 198 connections against a configured maximum of 200.
The primary was running, but the control-plane check did not test application queries.
Session termination was proposed; the note contains no execution record.

hypotheses.text: Connection-slot pressure may explain the application connection failures.
gaps: Session ownership and pool behavior are not included.

hypotheses.text: The recent reporting-worker rollout could be worth comparing against session ownership.
gaps: The bundle contains no evidence that the reporting worker consumed the connection slots.

missingInformation.text: Recovery and the outcome of any intervention are unknown.
missingInformation.whyItMatters: A proposed intervention is not proof of execution or restoration.
missingInformation.nextCheck: Collect action audit records and later application query checks.

missingInformation.text: The client sessions responsible for connection pressure are unknown.
missingInformation.whyItMatters: The connection sample does not attribute sessions to applications.
missingInformation.nextCheck: Inspect session ownership, age and pool settings.

missingInformation.text: Affected-user count and total incident duration are unknown.
missingInformation.whyItMatters: A single failing request cannot quantify the full impact.
missingInformation.nextCheck: Collect request trends and user-impact data beyond this bundle.

nextChecks.text: Inspect session ownership and application pool settings.
nextChecks.rationale: The connection sample is near the configured maximum and lacks client attribution.

nextChecks.text: Compare reporting-worker activity without assuming it caused the outage.
nextChecks.rationale: A rollout is recorded, but its connection-pool settings are absent.

nextChecks.text: Recheck application queries before concluding recovery.
nextChecks.rationale: The running control-plane state does not verify application query availability.
